questions.q: Set up the double integral of $f(x,y)=xy$ over the rectangle $[0,2]\times[0,3]$ (integrate $y$ first).
Evaluate $\int_0^2\int_0^3 xy\,dy\,dx$.
Evaluate $\int_0^1\int_0^2 (x^2+y)\,dy\,dx$.
Verify Fubini's Theorem for $f(x,y)=xy$ on $[0,1]\times[0,2]$ by evaluating the integral in both orders.
questions.answer: Order $dy\,dx$: inner $=x\cdot\frac{y^2}{2}|_0^2=2x$, outer $=\int_0^1 2x\,dx=1$. Order $dx\,dy$: inner $=y\cdot\frac{x^2}{2}|_0^1=\frac{y}{2}$, outer $=\int_0^2\frac{y}{2}\,dy=1$. Both orders give $1$.

sections.heading: Finding area with a double integral

questions.q: Use a double integral to find the area of the region bounded by $y=x^2$ and $y=2x$.
Evaluate $\iint_D \sqrt{x^2+y^2}\,dA$ where $D$ is the disk $x^2+y^2\leq9$, using polar coordinates.
questions.answer: $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}=r$, $dA=r\,dr\,d\theta$, so the integrand becomes $r^2$. $\int_0^{2\pi}\int_0^3 r^2\,dr\,d\theta$. Inner: $\dfrac{r^3}{3}\Big|_0^3=9$. Outer: $\int_0^{2\pi}9\,d\theta=18\pi$.

questions.q: Evaluate $\int_0^2\int_1^3 (2x+y)\,dy\,dx$.
Sketch the region for $\int_0^1\int_{\sqrt y}^1 x\,dx\,dy$ and rewrite it with the order of integration reversed.
questions.answer: The region is $0\leq y\leq1$, $\sqrt y\leq x\leq1$, i.e. between $x=\sqrt y$ (or $y=x^2$) and $x=1$, for $y$ from $0$ to $1$ — equivalently $0\leq x\leq1$, $0\leq y\leq x^2$. Reversed: $\displaystyle\int_0^1\int_0^{x^2} x\,dy\,dx$.

sections.heading: One more general-region setup and evaluation

questions.q: Set up $\iint_D y\,dA$ where $D$ is the region bounded by $y=0$, $y=x$, and $x=4$, integrating $y$ first.
Evaluate the integral set up above.
Evaluate $\iint_D 1\,dA$ (the area) where $D$ is the half-disk $x^2+y^2\leq4$, $y\geq0$, using polar coordinates.
questions.answer: $\theta\in[0,\pi]$, $r\in[0,2]$. $\int_0^\pi\int_0^2 r\,dr\,d\theta$. Inner: $\dfrac{r^2}{2}\Big|_0^2=2$. Outer: $\int_0^\pi2\,d\theta=2\pi$ (matches $\dfrac12\pi(2)^2=2\pi$, the known half-disk area formula).
